children: On September 17, 2026, the company notified the NYSE that it will voluntarily withdraw the primary listings of its common stock and trust securities and transfer them to the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE). Trading on the NYSE as primary listings is expected to end on October 2, 2026, with TXSE trading to begin on October 5, 2026, under the symbols DDS and DDT.
